about: Generated by generate_vectors.py; do not edit by hand. TEST KEYS ONLY: every key but one is derived from its seed_text (seed = SHA-256 of the text; Ed25519: the seed is the private key; ECDSA P-256: the scalar is the seed as a big-endian integer mod (n - 1), plus 1); the RSA key is the 2048-bit test key RFC 9500, section 2.1, publishes as testRSA2048, given here by its public modulus and exponent, as in the anchoring vectors. Records, exports and links are those of the anchoring vectors (R0 to R2 from portable verification); the specification is action binding's S0; witness-a-1 and the time-stamping authorities are anchoring 0.2.0's test keys, and the trust policy is anchoring 0.2.0's trust policy. Each assertion names the test key it was signed with (signed_with) and gives signed_bytes_hex, the bytes a verifier builds from it under the shared rule, and, where the key signed something else, signature_made_over_hex. A WebAuthn assertion also gives its challenge and the bytes the authenticator signed. Each token gives imprint_of_hex, the bytes its messageImprint is the SHA-256 of. A document's bytes as received (for attachment_digest and the documents' digests) are its JSON with no whitespace, in UTF-8.

escaped_copy.about: The attachment of DR-2099-101 written with the copy's value escaped (/ as \/). The rule replaces the value's characters, 88 here, whatever the writing: this writing gives the sealed digest, as the writing with no escape does (digest_replacing_the_value_characters); replacing the 92 written characters instead gives another digest (digest_replacing_the_written_characters), which is not the rule.
